Game Overview

Alien Slime puts players into a monster experience centered on embark on a daring quest as a gooey green alien in pixelated landscapes. Traverse challenging terrains, timing your moves perfectly to secure the diamond sword and save your world. With charming retro visuals and escalating difficulty, Alien Slime promises an enthralling adventure filled with nostalgic arcade excitement.
